confirmed_writer_cause.live_code_marker: PC=$B173 bytes 8E7544; helper cpu bytes and physical page-$23 bytes equal staged 3136-byte artifact before symbols interpreted
confirmed_writer_cause.address_derivation: Framebuffer is 320 pixels packed 4bpp, 160 bytes/row, virtual base $2000. Authored y14 anchor x136: $2000 + 112*160 + 136/2 = $6644. Authored heart row y17 currently starts $7544 = $2000 + 136*160 + 68.
confirmed_writer_cause.stride_rejected_hypothesis: Rejected. blit_packed_sprite advances X by 16*(8+152)=2560 bytes; LEAX -2552 yields net +8 bytes, exactly one 16-pixel packed 4bpp sprite step. Do not change loop stride; a +8 change would make a diagonal row.
confirmed_writer_cause.cause: The live natural writer starts the three selected variable letter masks at authored heart y17 rather than authored letter y14. Current TMX removed all 12 heart tile cells y17-18 while retaining the 12 letter tile cells y14-15. Natural preview therefore shows variable letters below the existing authored/other-rendered letter row and no authored hearts.
confirmed_writer_cause.stage_current_map_rows: Pre-122 authored map has y14-15 letters and y17-18 hearts; delivered map retains y14-15 and clears y17-18.
confirmed_writer_cause.stride_equation: 2560 + (-2552) = +8 bytes, equal to 16 pixels at 4bpp; observed anchors x136, x152, x168 stay on one row.
confirmed_writer_cause.first_preview_mismatch: At authored heart y17/y18 rectangle, first row-major pixel color mismatch is (143,140): expected palette index 4, actual 3; first silhouette-presence mismatch is (142,142): expected 4, actual 0.

No capacity, timing, or build result is claimed.
